crises.label: COVID-19
crises.measure: Employee jobs (all), relative to the median occupation

placebo.measure: all-employee jobs, one-year log change, occupations with at least 50,000 jobs
placebo.rule: Shown on cards only if the spread between careers (robust SD) is at least 1.25x the ordinary-year median

crises.label: After the cost-of-living shock
crises.measure: Real median full-time pay, tax year 2022/23 (peak inflation) to 2024/25, relative to the median occupation

placebo.measure: full-time median pay, two-year log change, occupations with CV at most 10%
placebo.rule: Shown on cards only if the spread between careers (robust SD) is at least 1.25x the ordinary-year median

crises.label: Hiring slump
crises.measure: Online job adverts by category (de-duplicated), January-June 2022 to January-June 2024, relative to the median occupation's category

placebo.note: Not testable: the advert series starts in 2018, so there are no ordinary two-year windows.

crises.label: 2008 financial crisis
crises.measure: Employee jobs (all), SOC 2000, relative to the median occupation

placebo.measure: all-employee jobs, one-year log change, occupations with at least 50,000 jobs
placebo.rule: Shown on cards only if the spread between careers (robust SD) is at least 1.25x the ordinary-year median
